label: Static Site / Markdown Blog
description: A prerendered static site of markdown posts with front matter: paginated index, post pages, tag pages, RSS + Atom feeds, sitemap, llms.txt, raw markdown per post, drafts — no API, no database; `npm run build` writes dist/ for any static host

VITE_SITE_URL.description: Public origin of the site, for absolute URLs in feeds, sitemap and llms.txt

BASE_PATH.description: Sub-path the site is served from (build-time; `BASE_PATH=/my-site npm run build`)
